title: Chronos-Theta s Aether-Delta: A Zig-Based Userspace Kernel for Height-Balanced Search
topic: Greg Kurtzer s Ginux is now a userspace kernel
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a lightweight userspace kernel, Chronos-Theta s Aether-Delta, implemented in Zig, that realizes a height-balanced search tree with strict key ordering and logarithmic search and insertion costs. The design leverages Zig's compile-time guarantees to enforce structural invariants and to expose a minimal runtime API for cooperative task scheduling. Formal analysis shows that every node satisfies the AVL height-balance condition, yielding $O(\log N)$ point and range queries and $O(\log N)$ updates. Static abstract syntax tree inspection confirms a concise implementation of 91 source lines and 7 function blocks, with no dynamic memory fragmentation. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/zig-systems-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261111_090253_greg_kurtzer_s_ginux_is_now_a}.
